Surrounded by the Soc Son Mountains

overviewParagraphs: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort is located in the beautiful mountainous area of Soc Son, roughly an hour from Hanoi's city center. It holds the prestigious title of being the very first golf course in Vietnam designed by the legendary Nicklaus Design firm.

The defining feature of Legend Hill is its innovative "twin green" concept. Each of the 18 holes has been designed with two separate, completely different greens. This means that depending on the day's setup, the strategic puzzle of the hole changes entirely, offering a 36-hole experience within an 18-hole footprint.

The course is impeccably maintained, with lush Paspalum grass providing an excellent playing surface year-round. The impressive neoclassical clubhouse, which sits atop a hill overlooking the layout, adds to the grandeur of the experience, making Legend Hill a standout in Northern Vietnam.
curatorBriefHtml: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort (opened 2015 in Soc Son, just 20 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport) is Jack Nicklaus Design’s first course in Vietnam and introduces a rare architectural twist: twin greens on every single hole. Playing 7,068 yards (Par 72) across the rolling Soc Son foothills north of Hanoi, golfers effectively experience two completely different 18-hole routing personalities depending on which green complex is in play.

Because Legend Hill sits only 20 minutes from Hanoi’s international terminal and 40 minutes north of the Old Quarter, it is one of Northern Vietnam’s smartest arrival-day or departure-day rounds. Wide undulating fairways reward confident tee shots, while elevated Nicklaus greens guarded by sculpted bunkers place a premium on crisp distance control.
On a Hanoi itinerary, AGS pairs BRG Legend Hill cleanly with Sky Lake and Thanh Lanh Valley, dispatching private vehicles directly from Hanoi’s luxury hotels or Noi Bai Airport.

scorecard.verdict: The first course in Vietnam designed by Nicklaus Design featuring a unique 'twin green' system that varies the pin angles and strategy every day. Impeccable turf and majestic mountain vistas.

faqs.q: How does the twin-green concept work at BRG Legend Hill?
faqs.a: Nicklaus Design built two completely distinct greens on every single hole — each with different approach angles, bunker protection, and contours. The club alternates pin placements between green sets, allowing a 36-hole visit to feel like two separate courses.

faqs.q: How far is BRG Legend Hill from Noi Bai International Airport and Hanoi?
faqs.a: Legend Hill is just 15–20 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) and roughly 40–50 minutes north of central Hanoi, making it ideal for an arrival or departure round.

faqs.q: What kind of challenge does BRG Legend Hill offer mid-handicappers?
faqs.a: Fairways are generous and scenic across the Soc Son hills, so tee shots feel fair, while the true Nicklaus exam arrives on approach shots into elevated, well-bunkered greens.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play BRG Legend Hill?
faqs.a: October through April offers cool, dry Northern Vietnam playing weather (18–26°C) and crisp Paspalum greens. Early morning tee times are best during the warmer May–September summer.
